papers.why: The paper makes microgel particles with seven different amounts of crosslinker and prints how much each swells, so the dose-versus-swelling series can be copied out.

records.label: PNIPAM microgel swelling ratio (d20C/d50C) vs MBA crosslinker dose, Table 1

inputs.unit: dimensionless (alpha = d20C/d50C, ratio of hydrodynamic diameters)

quotes.text: The DLS data were further evaluated to calculate the maximum swelling ratio, α=d20∘C/d50∘C,

records.note: Values are means; the printed uncertainties (0.070, 0.064, 0.051, 0.021, 0.043, 0.031, 0.029) are dropped. Swelling is a diameter ratio, not a volume ratio. Swelling falls as crosslinker dose rises. Intermediate rows (5.0 to 15.0) are read from the same table as the two quoted rows. Table text came through a page summarizer, so the row layout was inferred from the caption.
